footnote_text: Shares owned by the Robert H. Steers 2018 Revocable Trust.  Mr. Steers and a member of his immediate family serve as trustees of the trust.  Mr. Steers disclaims beneficial ownership of these shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest.

The Grandview Vision Foundation (the "Foundation") is a Section 501(c)(3) charitable organization. Mr. Steers and members of his immediate family serve as trustees of the Foundation and share voting and dispositive power over the shares held by the Foundation. Mr. Steers has no pecuniary interest in the shares held by the Foundation and reports such shares on a voluntary basis.
